name: pf-fix-weaponswap-pad
about: fix-weaponswap-pad against the built package qol instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Weapon swap on a controller (issue #14, hwplib HWP::Input): D-pad left by default swaps in gameplay, not with the character menu open (MenuLeft there; X still swaps there), the hints show the button while a controller is in use, the Plus tab row captures a button (B ignored, Esc cancels), the old button stops and the new one swaps, a clash with Use is named. GameLab presses emulated buttons (gamelab-hands pad verb). hwp pad lists the button codes.

steps.name: pad buttons resolve (gp: SDL controller buttons; ds4: joystick buttons, the D-pad a hat)
